decision_question: How much fixed wage is scheduled?
interpretation_boundary: Partial fixed-wage commitment; not total contract cost.

formula: fixed-wage commitment / current public market value
decision_question: How large is the commitment relative to the public asset estimate?
interpretation_boundary: Not ROI, book value, or accounting exposure.

formula: proposed annual wage / prior annual wage − 1
decision_question: How much does fixed pay change?
interpretation_boundary: Public prior wage may be missing or estimated.

formula: proposed fixed commitment − modeled peer commitment
decision_question: How unusual is the offer in euro terms?
interpretation_boundary: Historical deviation is not proof of overpayment.

formula: percentile of log commitment residual in frozen out-of-time reference distribution
decision_question: Where does the offer sit among historical extension deviations?
interpretation_boundary: Not an optimality, fairness, or causal score.

formula: fixed wages through 24m × P(not meaningful contributor through Year 2)
decision_question: How much two-year fixed commitment is exposed to low contribution risk?
interpretation_boundary: Not expected accounting loss or wasted wages.

formula: P(≥25% decline) displayed with 25% × current public market value
decision_question: What is the probability and minimum threshold magnitude of a material public-value decline?
interpretation_boundary: Do not multiply into expected loss; not resale proceeds or impairment.

formula: 36m continuous-stay probability displayed with scheduled fixed wages after month 36
decision_question: How much contract extends beyond the modeled continuity horizon?
interpretation_boundary: Outbound movement can stop wages or produce a fee; this is not expected loss.

formula: percentile among known club salary panel
decision_question: Where would the player sit in the club wage hierarchy?
interpretation_boundary: Known public salary panel may be incomplete.

formula: annual fixed wage / total known club fixed wages
decision_question: How concentrated is known payroll in this player?
interpretation_boundary: Denominator is not audited total payroll.
